text: 0253 found K4 beating its copies far more often than chance allows, with gibberish readings. Is K4 special, or the test?
Four scrambled copies of K4 play K4: each gets its own fitting schedules and exactly the same procedure.
The stand-ins beat their copies in 1.5% to 17.5% of schedules; K4 in 13.3%, second of five. The rate belongs to the text, shared across its schedules, so 0253's p was wrong; 40 stand-ins next (0255).
